mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to future corporate cash flows, increasing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 210, it signals persistent high inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 210.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,050,000 units, it signals a strong housing market that drives consumer confidence and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1050.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (GDPC1 > 11700), strong GDP levels signal potential overvaluation and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 11700.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210) and elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) signal a restrictive monetary policy environment that suppresses corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 210 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.
